notes: Cloudflare Cache Rules execute top-to-bottom as non-terminating set_cache_settings actions where later matching rules override earlier ones.
Rule 4 (verification nonce bypass) MUST remain last so publisher verification requests with ?r2v=, ?v2r=, or ?publication_check= bypass cache even on immutable and legacy v1 paths.
Error status codes 400-599 use value -1 (no-store), never 0 (force revalidation), so 404/410 and transient origin failures are never negatively cached.
Only exact catalog hostnames are matched; scan-stash.com root, legal pages, mail, and unrelated subdomains are untouched.

rules.description: ScanStash staging: cache immutable catalog releases and v2 price builds, never store errors
rules.expression: (http.host eq "catalog-staging.scan-stash.com") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/magic/v1/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/one-piece/v1/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/yugioh/v1/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/market-prices/v2/builds/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/market-prices/v2/verified-builds/"))

rules.description: ScanStash staging: bypass edge cache for legacy v1 price index and group files so v1 clients never mix builds with last-updated.txt
ScanStash staging: bypass edge cache for mutable catalog pointers, scopes, and pricing markers
ScanStash staging: bypass edge cache for publisher verification requests with nonce query parameters
rules.expression: (http.host eq "catalog-staging.scan-stash.com") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/magic/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/one-piece/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/yugioh/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/market-prices/")) and (starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "r2v=") or contains(http.request.uri.query, "&r2v=") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "v2r=") or contains(http.request.uri.query, "&v2r=") or starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "publication_check=") or contains(http.request.uri.query, "&publication_check="))
